body:
#2839 (S4c) now at 9985d93bf2 with your 15:12 rulings applied:
(1) As approved. Each no-knob fallback (review, --path re-entry, --path outside the parent) now prints a one-line `note:` naming its reason, so no downgrade is silent.
(2) As modified:
- No knob and no origin: the seat resolves to a linked worktree and prints a note ("this checkout has no `origin` remote to clone from").
- Explicit seat_tree = "clone" with no origin: refuses up front with "add an origin remote or set seat_tree = \"worktree\"".
- The logic is one pure function, seat_clone::default_clone_fallback.
Tests:
- default_clone_fallback_notes_each_reason_and_explicit_never_downgrades: unit test of every branch, both explicit and default.
- the_default_without_an_origin_keeps_a_worktree: end-to-end session start.
- session_start_refuses_a_contained_seat_it_cannot_clone_for: now covers both explicit-no-origin (the actionable message) and an origin that cannot be cloned (the O1 message). Both cases write no lease and create no worktree.
Docs: 03-work-autonomy.md updated.
Gates: check-ci-fast 34/34; test-touched 2880 + 165 + 3 green.
#2836 and #2839 are still stacked on #2833 (at 367532bb54, READY). After #2833 merges I'll retarget and rebase them. The operator merges #2839 (C3).
subject: #2839 S4c rulings applied at 9985d93bf2
